pillars.headline: Three things that separate our compliance from a generic vendor's

items.title: We employ in your markets - every day, at scale
items.description: J&F owns the entities in all 17+ markets we operate in. The compliance team supporting you handles the same regulators, tax authorities, and statutory updates for our own operations every month — as in-market operators, not advisors reading circulars from abroad. Some providers route through partner networks; ours is the same team you'd reach, in the same country, applying rules we already live by.

items.title: A team plus a system - both, together
items.description: Our legal and compliance specialists across the markets we cover track regulatory changes continuously, backed by a system that surfaces updates the moment they land. Automation catches what humans miss; humans catch what automation isn't built to see. You get both.

items.title: Pricing that reflects your situation, not a package
items.description: Compliance in one country looks nothing like a multi-entity setup across five. Instead of a flat package, we quote based on your specific setup — and the quote comes back within 24 hours.

coverage.subheadline: One team covers all four areas below, in every market we operate in.

items.description: Contracts, working hours, leave entitlements, termination and severance, employee rights.

items.title: Tax
items.description: Income tax withholding, social security contributions, payroll tax filing, year-end reporting.

items.title: Benefits and statutory requirements
items.description: Pension contributions, statutory leave, health insurance, local benefit mandates.

items.title: Regulatory monitoring
items.description: Legislative changes tracked continuously, with updates applied to your setup as they happen.

process.headline: How it works, and how long each step takes

steps.title: Assessment
steps.description: We review your current position — contracts, policies, payroll, workforce structure — against the requirements in each market you operate in. You get a clear picture of where you stand within 48 hours.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: We put the gaps right: updated policies, aligned contracts, documentation, and any needed process changes. A single-market update moves faster than a multi-entity overhaul.

steps.title: Monitoring
steps.description: Compliance drift is the harder problem, not the initial setup. Our team tracks regulatory changes in your markets continuously and flags what needs your attention before it matters.

items.question: Why is compliance important?
items.answer: Non-compliance risks fines, legal liability, operational disruption, and reputational damage. Beyond that, having a team accountable in each of your markets means issues get caught before they escalate — early, not after.

items.question: How do you monitor regulatory changes?
items.answer: Our compliance team — specialists in each market we operate in — tracks changes continuously, backed by a system that flags updates as they happen. Ongoing, not periodic.

items.question: What happens if I'm not compliant?
items.answer: We start with an assessment (within 48 hours) to identify the gaps, then move to implementation — typically 2 to 6 weeks depending on scope and number of markets. Monitoring is continuous from there, so you don't drift back out.

items.question: How does EOR help with compliance?
items.answer: With EOR, J&F becomes the legal employer, and full compliance responsibility transfers to us — not just monitoring and advisory. Learn more about EOR →

items.question: What countries do you cover?
items.answer: We hold direct entities in 17+ markets: Belgium, China, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Hong Kong, India, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain, UAE, and the UK. For markets outside this list, our reach extends further — contact us →.

items.question: Do you help with GDPR and data privacy compliance?
items.answer: Yes. GDPR and data privacy compliance is part of our service. We help with data processing agreements, privacy notices, and cross-border data flows, so employee and client data is handled in line with applicable privacy laws in each market.

items.question: What if we already have a local entity?
items.answer: Compliance support works alongside an existing entity — you don't need to give it up. This sits closer to our standalone compliance service than to EOR (since EOR specifically means J&F becomes the legal employer). Where you have entities, we support compliance monitoring, policy reviews, and advisory; where you don't, EOR can remove the burden entirely.

items.question: How do you handle works council and employee representation?
items.answer: Where works councils or employee representation apply, we work within the required processes and support information and consultation obligations. Our local teams understand these requirements in each jurisdiction.
